title: Demi Lovato Is Releasing New Song ‘Low Rise Jeans’ After Debuting It During Show: Here’s When It Arrives
summary: The Grammy-nominated pop sensation has a new banger for the springtime.
contentText:
Spring is in full bloom — and Demi Lovato is dropping a new anthem for the season.

Related

The Grammy-nominated pop star shared a picture of herself cupping her derriére in a pair of low-rise jeans on her Instagram page on Wednesday (April 17). “‘Low Rise Jeans’ out Friday, 4.17,” she wrote in the all-caps caption, confirming the release date for her new song.

Lovato debuted “Low Rise Jeans” early in the set of her It’s Not That Deep Tour kickoff at Orlando’s Kia Center on Monday (April 13). The following day, she shared a clip of her performance to both her official TikTok and Instagram Reels pages, garnering more than five million combined views. “I’m in my low-rise jeans/ You don’t need your imagination/ In my see-through tee/ I can feel your anticipation,” she croons in the chorus.

The Orlando show — which brought out stars such as Selena Gomez and guest performer Joe Jonas — marked the first stop of her 18-date, arena-headlining tour of the United States and Canada. In addition to treating fans to the first live performance of “Jeans,” the powerhouse singer also played the new jam over the arena’s speakers at the end of the show.

With Dream Academy alum Adéla serving as the trek’s supporting act, Lovato launched the It’s Not That Deep Tour in honor of her 2025 album of the same name. It’s Not That Deep arrived last November and became Lovato’s ninth project to reach the top 10 of the Billboard 200 (No. 9). The 11-track set, which also debuted atop Dance Albums, found the Disney Channel alum returning to a more dance-forward pop sound, with singles such as “Fast” and “Kiss,” the former of which she performed at the 2026 GLAAD Media Awards on March 5.

In addition to her buzzy tour, Lovato is also making inroads in film this year. Tow , a drama in which she stars opposite Oscar nominee Rose Byrne, hit select U.S. theaters on March 20, and she’s also executive producing Camp Rock 3 , which is expected to debut on Disney+ this summer.
